title: AI Avatars in Social Work Education
description: Open educational resource (interactive web guide; CC BY-NC 4.0) developed for the UTA Center for Research on Teaching and Learning Excellence (CRTLE) Professional Learning Community, Future-Ready Teaching: Artificial Intelligence, 2025–2026. Provides four branching AI avatar case videos (each with an on-screen decision point and two practice paths), case-based teaching strategies, and ethics guidance for using AI avatars in social work education. Released April 13, 2026; major revision September 23, 2026; branching case videos added October 17, 2026; co-author citation, AI-use statement, and creator wording updated October 20, 2026. Live at https://ai-avatars-in-socialwork.netlify.app
